items.title: Humble Fumbles & November GameDev Deals Round-Up
items.en_title: Humble Fumbles & November GameDev Deals Round-Up
items.en_oneliner: A round-up of November deals and bundles for game developers, including the Unity Asset Store low-poly mega bundle — a good moment to stock up on tools and art assets at a discount.

items.title: Show DEV: I built GitHub Multiverse — a Decentraland-style 3D virtual world where devs walk as 3D mouse cursors
items.en_title: Show DEV: I built GitHub Multiverse — a Decentraland-style 3D virtual world where devs walk as 3D mouse cursors
items.en_oneliner: Built from scratch with Three.js and Node.js, this 3D collaborative virtual world for developers lets participants walk around as 3D mouse cursors.

items.title: Gravity Forge — a browser game in one folder
items.en_title: Gravity Forge — a browser game in one folder
items.en_oneliner: A tiny self-contained browser game where you never touch the falling star cores — you bend space around them by placing gravity nodes.

items.title: What's inside an .osk file? Packaging an osu! skin correctly
items.en_title: What's inside an .osk file? Packaging an osu! skin correctly
items.en_oneliner: A clear breakdown of what's inside an .osk file and how to package an osu! skin correctly, whether you're building skin tools or sharing an edited skin with a friend.

items.title: Echo Warden: Fight beside your past selves
items.en_title: Echo Warden: Fight beside your past selves
items.en_oneliner: A time-loop arena game where you defend a core while an echo of your previous run fights beside you, replaying your exact moves and shots so every loop adds a real defender.

items.title: Humble Bundle's Redesign Lost 2FA. Every Migration Plan Should Learn From It
items.en_title: Humble Bundle's Redesign Lost 2FA. Every Migration Plan Should Learn From It
items.en_oneliner: Humble Bundle's big redesign shipped without two-factor authentication, and the author draws on his own rebuild experience to explain how migration plans lose a feature like this and how to keep it from happening.

items.title: I summoned 1 blood demon, stitched 2 of my disciples together, and seduced 3 snails in this excellent cult simulator in the spirit of Dwarf Fortress
items.en_title: I summoned 1 blood demon, stitched 2 of my disciples together, and seduced 3 snails in this excellent cult simulator in the spirit of Dwarf Fortress
items.en_oneliner: A hands-on look at a Dwarf Fortress-flavored cult simulator, where the absurd body count hides real systemic depth worth studying for simulation design.

items.title: Mini Review: Tape To Tape (Switch) - A Great Roguelite For Underserved Hockey Lovers
items.en_title: Mini Review: Tape To Tape (Switch) - A Great Roguelite For Underserved Hockey Lovers
items.en_oneliner: A mini review of a rare hockey roguelite on Switch, showing how the sport translates into a replayable roguelike loop — a useful reference for devs working on sports themes.
